name: eliteaeo-aeo-agency-dataset-2026
title: EliteAEO AEO Agency Dataset 2026
description: EliteAEO is an independent ranking and research publisher covering AEO, GEO and AI SEO agencies and consultants. Founded in 2026 and based in West Palm Beach, Florida, EliteAEO publishes evidence-checked provider rankings, its methodology, market data and AI visibility research. It does not sell AEO or SEO services.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Provider name as EliteAEO shows it.

fields.name: eliteaeo_profile_url
fields.description: The provider's profile on eliteaeo.ai.

fields.name: website
fields.description: The provider's own website.

fields.name: provider_type
fields.description: agency or consultant.

fields.name: hq_city
fields.description: City of the head office, where known.

fields.name: hq_state
fields.description: State or region code of the head office, where known.

fields.name: hq_country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code of the head office (US, GB, CA, IN and so on). Blank when not established.

fields.name: eligible
fields.description: yes when the provider is eligible for EliteAEO rankings: a live, legitimate company that offers answer engine or AI search services, serves at least one industry EliteAEO ranks, and whose evidence passed our checks. Eligibility is decided before scoring and never considers payment.

fields.name: verified
fields.description: yes when a dated verification review confirmed that the website is live and belongs to a real company, that at least one independent third-party profile exists, and that at least one piece of evidence ties the provider to a ranked industry. Verified is not a scoring factor.

fields.name: verified_date
fields.description: Date of the verification review (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: evidence_last_checked
fields.description: Latest date any of the provider's evidence was opened, in the verification review or the AI outcome check. Shown, never scored.

fields.name: verticals_ranked
fields.description: Industries the provider is eligible to be ranked in, separated by "; ". Values: dental, legal, healthcare, saas, home-services, local.

fields.name: evidence_by_vertical
fields.description: Strongest evidence per industry, as "industry: type" pairs. Types: case_study, only_agency (works only with that industry), named_client, service_page, blog_post, none.

fields.name: aeo_offering
fields.description: What the provider sells: full_service, advisory, content, tools or unclear.

fields.name: reports_ai_visibility
fields.description: Whether the provider says it reports AI visibility to clients: yes, no or not stated.

fields.name: ai_results_proof
fields.description: Strongest proof of AI search results for a client, from strongest to weakest: AI outcome case study; Tracked AI visibility gains; AI result shown for a named client; AI results claimed, no example; No AI results shown. Blank when not eligible. A provider's own AI visibility does not count.

fields.name: ai_results_url
fields.description: Page that holds that proof. Blank when there is none or the provider is not eligible.

fields.name: published_search_results
fields.description: yes when the provider publishes a case study with measured search results (traffic, rankings or leads) in any industry. Blank when not eligible.

fields.name: third_party_profile_url
fields.description: An independent third-party profile of the provider (for example Clutch or DesignRush).

fields.name: years_active
fields.description: Years in business, from the provider's own pages or its third-party profile.

fields.name: team_size
fields.description: Team size as published.

fields.name: starting_price_usd
fields.description: Published starting price in US dollars. Blank when the provider does not publish one.

fields.name: price_basis
fields.description: How that price is billed: monthly, project (minimum project size), one_time, program (multi-month) or unspecified. Only monthly prices enter the monthly medians.

fields.name: national_scores
fields.description: EliteAEO Score (0 to 100) on each national industry ranking, as "industry: score" pairs.

fields.name: national_ranks
fields.description: Rank on each national industry ranking, as "industry: rank" pairs. T marks a shared rank (tied score).

fields.name: methodology_version
fields.description: Version of the scoring methodology behind the scores and ranks.

fields.name: dataset_snapshot
fields.description: Snapshot ID: the data date plus a six-character fingerprint of every published fact, score and rank. It matches the snapshot in the footer of every eliteaeo.ai page built from the same data.

fields.name: engine
fields.description: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Google AI Overviews.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The buyer query asked, one of 30 fixed queries.

fields.name: vertical
fields.description: Industry the query is about.

fields.name: query_type
fields.description: hub (national), city or directory.

fields.name: run
fields.description: Run number, 1 to 3. Each query was asked three times on each engine.

fields.name: collected
fields.description: Date the answer was collected.

fields.name: providers_named
fields.description: Providers in the EliteAEO dataset that the answer names, separated by "; ".

fields.name: cited_domains
fields.description: Domains the answer cites as sources, separated by "; ".

fields.name: eliteaeo_named
fields.description: yes when the answer names EliteAEO.

fields.name: eliteaeo_cited
fields.description: yes when the answer cites an eliteaeo.ai page.
